segments.text: On August 18, 1945, Netaji was en route to Tokyo when his Imperial Japanese Air Force bomber had severe engine trouble upon takeoff in Taipei, Taiwan.
The aircraft crashed and Netaji suffered third-degree burns, being rushed to Nanmon Military Hospital in Taipei.
Netaji passed away hours later, leaving an immortal legacy of fearlessness, unity, and sacrifice that ignited India's ultimate independence.
